name: Saumya Tandon
bio:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Saumya Tandon (3 November 1984) is an Indian actress. Recently she co-hosted Zor Ka Jhatka: Total Wipeout (Based on the Wipeout format) with Shah Rukh Khan in 2011. She was the host for Dance India Dance. She starred in the Imtiaz Ali directed movie Jab We Met, starring Shahid Kapoor and Kareena Kapoor, where she plays the role of Kareena's sister, Roop. She is also known for her role in the Sony TV aired soap Aisa Des Hai Mera, where she plays the role of a half-Brit girl named Rusty.
